messages:
Priya: Heads-up — after the role-template refactor this morning I’m seeing analytics-app-role grant read access to s3://customer-blobstore for org-783. Need immediate triage.

deploy-bot: Deploy finished: infra/roles @ 2026-03-19T09:12Z by alex.

Owen: Can you paste the policy diff that caused this?

Priya: Short snippet from the merged template:
```
-    "Resource": "arn:aws:s3:::internal-logs/*",
-    "Effect": "Deny"
+    "Resource": "arn:aws:s3:::customer-blobstore/*",
+    "Effect": "Allow"
```
It looks like a templating variable got swapped during the refactor.

Maya: If that diff is accurate this is a data exposure. Immediate mitigations: 1) add org-level deny for analytics svcacct on customer-blobstore, 2) collect KMS decrypt logs, 3) prepare CMK rotation plan.

Alex: I just pushed an org deny for svcacct:analytics@redwood to block s3:GetObject/PutObject on customer-blobstore — applied and propagated. Holding rollback of the role-template deploy.

Priya: Confirming — analytics tasks now get AccessDenied for customer-blobstore. Blocking appears effective. :thumbsup: 

Charlie: KMS CloudTrail shows decrypt events at 2026-03-19T09:16Z and 09:18Z from analytics-task-runner (svcacct). Estimated ~120 objects accessed. Exporting object list to secure ticket INC-20260319-235.

security-bot: Incident INC-20260319-235 created. Notifying compliance, customer-success, and legal. Incident doc: https://redwood.internal/incidents/INC-20260319-235

Owen: We need timeline + blast radius for customer notifications. Priya, can you confirm number of customers affected and whether PII present?

Priya: Initial scan shows a single customer (org-783). A few files are third-party data exports — flagging for review. Will add details to the incident doc.

product-lead: Product approves emergency CMK rotation if security recommends it. Keep CS in the loop for messaging.

Maya: Requesting CMK rotate approval from compliance (copied). After rotate we will re-key objects and revoke old access. Also add a test to CI to detect templated resource var collisions.

Alex: Rolled back the role-template change in the infra repo and marked the PR as reverted. Deploy is blocked until postmortem and tests are in.

Owen: Good. Add a follow-up task to add a deny-by-default smoke test for any role refactor. Also file a quick SR to SRE to rate-limit analytics job for next 24h while we investigate.

Priya: Action plan recap in the incident doc: 1) org deny applied (done) 2) collect access logs + object list (Charlie) 3) CMK rotation (pending approval) 4) notify customer + CS with templated message (compliance) 5) postmortem + policy tests + PR revert (Alex/Priya). ETA for initial customer notif: ~2h.

Charlie: Uploaded object list and access samples to the secure incident folder.

Priya: Opening the postmortem and linking the reverted PR + follow-up issue. Thanks everyone for the quick response. :heart:

Maya: Please add an entry to the security runbook for "templated-role refactor checklist" so this doesn't recur.

Priya: Will do and assign to eng-infra.

Owen: Closing loop — once CMK rotation completes and compliance signs off, schedule a retro.

Priya: Will update incident and notify when we hit each milestone.
